quotes.quote: To evaluate the C-COMPASS steps comprising marker upsampling, multiorganelle localization predictions and output filtering, we applied the pipeline to a published dataset of human

white adipocytes containing 5,530 proteins separated via PCP across 24 fractions 22 (complete data in Supplementary Table 1 ). Predictions were compared to SVM outputs from the original study using the same 12-compartment marker set (Fig. 2a,b ).

G1.rationale: The principal result (F1 scores of C-COMPASS vs SVM) is produced by re-running the C-COMPASS neural network pipeline on the published adipocyte PCP dataset, which a third party can re-run.

quotes.quote: The overall F 1 score of C-COMPASS (0.84) slightly exceeded that of SVMs (0.80) (Extended Data Fig. 2c ).

G2.rationale: One principal quantitative result is named: the overall F1 score of C-COMPASS (0.84) versus SVMs (0.80), the paper's stated performance metric for its main application.

quotes.quote: The normalized profiles p ® ( s , r ) are processed independently. The network input has the dimension F , matching the number of fractions in that replicate. We then use two dense (fully connected) layers,

Input layer: size F . First hidden layer: dense layer with C + 0.4 × ( F − C ) to C + 0.6 × ( F − C ) neurons and a rectified linear unit activation function. The number of neurons is a hyperparameter. Second hidden layer: dense layer with C neurons and a linear activation function. Third

We employ Keras Hyperband to select the best-performing optimizer (stochastic gradient descent, root mean square propagation or adaptive moment estimation), the learning rate (logarithmically distributed within [10 −4 , 10 −1 ]) and the size of the first hidden layer.

G4.rationale: The Methods describe the network architecture, training, hyperparameter tuning, filtering and quality metrics in enough detail to implement without the original code.

quotes.quote: C-COMPASS was developed under Python v.3.8.8. The graphical user interface of C-COMPASS was developed using PySimpleGUI (v.4.55.1) in combination with Tkinter (v.8.6). Quality metrics were calculated using scikit-learn (v.0.24.1), while neural network predictions were executed using Keras (v.2.10.0) alongside TensorFlow

(v.2.10.0) and KerasTuner (v.1.4.5) for hyperparameter tuning. Additionally, C-COMPASS uses several libraries including NumPy (v.1.20.1), SciPy (v.1.6.2) and pandas (v.1.2.4). Image generation All figures were created using Adobe Illustrator v.24.3.

G5.rationale: The method is implemented in Python with open-source libraries (Keras, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NumPy, SciPy, pandas); no proprietary software is required for the computation.

method_quotes.quote: To evaluate the performance of compartment predictions, we calculated standard classification quality metrics, including precision, recall and F 1 score, using the scikit-learn Python package. Main protein annotations served as the ground truth, and predicted compartments were determined by selecting the compartment with the highest predicted CC c ( s ) value for each species s .

specification.input_notes: The Zenodo deposit 13901167 provides C-COMPASS_ProteomeInput.tsv (16.5 MB) and C-COMPASS_MarkerList.txt (49 KB) as the analysis inputs; C-COMPASS_session.npy is a processed session (output). The raw adipocyte PCP data are from Klingelhuber et al. (ref 22) and are not in this deposit; the deposit is described as an example dataset.

specification.comparison_metric: Compare the reported overall F1 score of C-COMPASS (0.84) and SVM (0.80) with the F1 score computed by re-running the C-COMPASS pipeline on the same adipocyte PCP dataset and marker set.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split: F1 scores must match to the displayed two decimal places (0.84 and 0.80).
specification.specification_gaps: The exact train/validation split, random seeds, and the precise marker list version used for the adipocyte dataset are not fully specified; the deposit's proteome input may be a processed example rather than the raw adipocyte PCP data.
